Bengaluru Residents Protest Flyover Tenders, Demand Metro Upgrade

Residents of South Bengaluru formed human chains to protest the cancellation of flyover tenders, expressing their opposition to an elevated corridor project. They are demanding an upgrade to the existing Metro system instead. The protests specifically targeted the tenders for the flyover.
